title: Birthday Budget Entry Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Gift registries (`gift:registry`), Amazon wishlists (`amazon:wishlist`), holiday card sends (`holiday:card`), birthday budgets (`birthday:budget`), and thank-you notes (`thankyou:note`).
app: Gift registry exports, Amazon wishlist snapshots, holiday card mail logs, birthday budget trackers, and thank-you note reminders ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=birthday:budget
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(recipient_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many birthday budget entry events land each day and how many distinct recipient values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest birthday budget entry records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct recipient values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how much birthday budget entry activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
